records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total net revenue for the three and six months ended June 30, 2021 increased by $2.8 billion, or 143%, and $6.4 billion, or 195%, compared to the three and six months ended June 30, 2020, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription and services-based revenue for the three and six months ended June 30, 2021 increased by $338.9 million, or 98%, and $600.3 million, or 93%, compared to the three and six months ended June 30, 2020, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Bitcoin revenue increased by $1.8 billion and $5.1 billion for the three and six months ended June 30, 2021 compared to the three and six months ended June 30, 2020, respectively, and represented 67% and 79% of the increase in total net revenue for the three and six months ended June 30, 2021, compared to the three and six months ended June 30, 2020, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the six months ended June 30, 2021, cash provided by operating activities was $297.8 million.
